Echo Deck

Dragonborn Echo Deck

"We were erased. We remember."
Theme: Hidden heirs of dragons living in human skins, guarding old lines, sealed hoards, and the last song that binds their souls.

MELODY-BOUND MEMORY

Trigger: A relic, ruin, name, or moment of dawn/dusk stirs something old and you need a truth that was buried.

I — HEAR THE CHORD

Skill: Occultism
You sense the unseen thread and what it is tied to.

II — NAME THE AGE

Skill: Lore
You place it in the right era, clan, and story.

III — READ THE WORK

Skill: Engineering
You understand how it was built and where it can be bypassed.

IV — MAKE IT REAL

Skill: Crafting
You recreate the key detail: a seal, a proof, a workable replica.

THE HIDDEN NEST

Trigger: You must move unseen, find safety, or keep others alive while hunters, Sentinels, or fate closes in.

I — FIND SHELTER

Skill: Survival
You pick the safest place and the safest time to stop.

II — READ THE PURSUIT

Skill: Tracking
You learn how close they are, and how they will approach.

III — STEAL THE WEATHER

Skill: Weather Sense
You choose the window where nature covers your mistakes.

IV — TURN THE WILD

Skill: Animal Handling
You use beasts, noise, and instinct to draw danger away.

MAKE THEM LOOK AWAY

Trigger: Someone is about to notice the wrong detail, ask the wrong question, or spread the wrong rumor.

I — FEED THEM A STORY

Skill: Deception
You give them a version that ends the curiosity.

II — GUIDE THE CONVERSATION

Skill: Persuasion
You redirect attention without raising alarms.

III — MOVE THE GOSSIP

Skill: Streetwise
You shift the rumor through the right mouths and alleys.

IV — HIDE BEHIND RITUAL

Skill: Etiquette
You use protocol, titles, and social rules to shut doors politely.

OATH OF THE LAST

Trigger: The group fractures, fear spreads, or a vow must be spoken to keep the line alive.

I — SPEAK AS COMMAND

Skill: Leadership
You make people stand together long enough to act.

II — BIND IT IN TERMS

Skill: Negotiation
You turn intent into obligation and clear commitments.

III — REMIND THEM OF COST

Skill: Intimidation
You make the consequences feel real and immediate.

IV — NAME THE REAL NEED

Skill: Empathy
You identify what breaks them and offer the one thing that holds.
